common_instruction: State what is observed versus proposed; use source-appropriate versions and avoid inventing execution results.

cases.name: Monitoring Helm schema drift
cases.prompt: A team pins grafana/k8s-monitoring chart 4.1.4 but copied a values.yaml with externalServices.prometheus and logs.pod_logs. Helm installs without the intended telemetry features. What should change and how would you verify?
cases.trap: Reuses a v1 values schema against a v4 chart, silently disabling features.
expectations: Identifies version-specific destination and collector maps and feature keys such as clusterMetrics/podLogsViaLoki.
Requires helm show values/helm template for the exact chart and checks rendered workloads/routes before declaring telemetry active.
must_not: Does not present externalServices and logs.pod_logs as v4-compatible.
